originalTitle: 9 penny stocks surge up to 325% in 2026 so far; 3 turn multibaggers. Did you own any?
simplifiedContent: Some very cheap stocks, called "penny stocks", have increased in value by as much as 325% this year. This means that if you invested in one of these stocks at the beginning of the year, your investment could be more than three times bigger now. A few of these stocks have done even better, becoming "multibaggers", which means their value has increased many times over. This is significant because it shows that some investors have made a lot of money from these stocks, but it's also important to remember that penny stocks can be very risky. These big gains might encourage some investors to take a closer look at these stocks, to see if they want to invest in them too.

originalTitle: Bonus, stock splits & dividends: Bandhan Bank, MGL, Mazagon Dock among nearly 100 stocks turning ex-record date this week
simplifiedContent: This week, about 100 companies, including Bandhan Bank and LIC Housing Finance, have important dates coming up related to dividends, bonus shares, and stock splits. To be eligible for these benefits, investors need to own the company's shares before the specified date, known as the record date. If you own shares in one of these companies before the record date, you might receive extra money or shares as a dividend or bonus. This is a significant event because it can affect the value of your investment and give you more shares or cash. It's essential for investors to be aware of these dates to ensure they don't miss out on potential benefits.

originalTitle: Will Sensex, Nifty continue to bleed on Monday? 4 factors which will drive D-Street action this week
simplifiedContent: Here's what you need to know about the stock market right now: the main Indian stock indexes, Sensex and Nifty, fell last week and might stay at similar levels this week. This is because investors are worried about a few things, including high oil prices and uncertainty around the world. Analysts are watching four main factors that could affect the stock market this week: oil prices, what's happening in other countries, the risk of inflation, and big geopolitical events. These factors could make investors cautious and affect how the stock market performs. Overall, it's a uncertain time for the stock market, and investors are being careful.

originalTitle: Indian stock market: How are Sensex and Nifty 50 likely to perform next week amid US-Iran war uncertainty?
simplifiedContent: The Indian stock market had a tough week, with two main indexes, Sensex and Nifty 50, falling in value. The Sensex decreased by 0.62% to 78,009.25, and the Nifty 50 decreased by 0.83% to 24,366. The smaller companies' stocks had mixed results, with some going up and others going down. This means that overall, the market didn't do very well last week. The performance of the market is being watched closely, especially with uncertain events like the US-Iran conflict happening, which could affect the market's direction next week.
